r.ScreenPercentage.quality_impact: Renders at lower internal resolution, so the image looks softer

r.Shadow.CSM.MaxCascades.quality_impact: Less shadow detail on distant objects

r.VolumetricFog.quality_impact: Removes light shafts and fog volumes

r.MotionBlurQuality.quality_impact: Low (cosmetic): less or no motion blur; many players turn it off anyway

r.LensFlareQuality.quality_impact: Low (cosmetic): removes lens flares around bright lights

r.SceneColorFringeQuality.quality_impact: Low (cosmetic): removes chromatic aberration (color fringing at screen edges)

r.BloomQuality.quality_impact: Low: glow around bright areas is slightly less smooth

r.DepthOfFieldQuality.quality_impact: Low: background/foreground blur is slightly rougher

r.SSR.Quality.quality_impact: Medium: screen-space reflections get noisier and less detailed

r.VolumetricFog.GridPixelSize.quality_impact: Low: coarser fog and light shafts (fog stays on)

r.ShadowQuality.quality_impact: Medium: shadows get softer and less precise

r.Lumen.ScreenProbeGather.DownsampleFact.quality_impact: Medium: Lumen indirect lighting gets blotchier, especially in small details

r.Nanite.MaxPixelsPerEdge.quality_impact: Low to medium: Nanite meshes use slightly fewer triangles, fine detail softens

r.SkeletalMeshLODBias.quality_impact: Low: characters use one lower level of detail

r.ViewDistanceScale.quality_impact: Low to medium (CPU lever): small distant objects stop drawing sooner and may pop in closer

foliage.DensityScale.quality_impact: Low at 0.75, medium at 0.5 (CPU lever): sparser grass and plants
